name: Sticky
text: Sticks to the first creature it lands by and rides it into its pack before it blows.
vfx: the grenade rides on a creature's back, blinking, then blows
art_prompt: a grenade coated in dripping yellow glue with a suction pad

A.note: the grenade's: a glossy amber grenade with a blinking light

B.note: B · amber tar poured over the stick (or the bundle), dripping; its spark kept (no amber tint, no blinking light)

recipe.subject: The reference image shows the stick of dynamite to draw: keep its shape, parts and colours. A bright red paper stick of dynamite with dark rings and cream ends with thick glossy golden amber tar poured over its middle: the amber tar coats the top of the stick with a shiny highlight and runs down its sides in fat drips that hang off its underside, the red paper showing at both ends, the fuse sticking out past the tar with the fuse lit: a big bright yellow and orange spark burst fizzing at its tip with a few tiny sparks flying off, easy to see, plain paper with no letters, numbers or writing anywhere on it, lying diagonally
